_comment: Surveillance = ZED_SURVEILLANCE (this host's database). Main = ZEDCS_V2_LIVE, read-only login, for features that read main's data (agency and assessor accounts are mastered there).

Portal._comment: Served under the old IIS application /surveillance (the Angular build uses baseHref /surveillance/). PublicBaseUrl includes it, so mail links open this portal. StorageRoot must be the SAME folder as main's Portal:StorageRoot (surveillance certificates are stored under main's Surveillance/Certificates/...); set it to that absolute path on the server.
